breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to replace the uniform distributed load with its resultant point load at midspan (W = wL = 900 N) and use the point load formula QL³/(48EI) instead of the correct UDL formula 5wL⁴/(384EI). It even states 'do NOT use the standard UDL formula.' This directly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth simply asks to use superposition of the two standard cases, meaning the correct UDL midspan deflection formula (5wL⁴/384EI) should be used for the distributed load contribution.
